message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This DLL component scan used only `DLL_software_component.txt`; duplicate package names and obvious naming variants were consolidated. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined. The scan window was **2026-10-13 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-14 07:40 UTC** (**2026-10-13 13:10 IST through 2026-10-14 13:10 IST**).

No new vulnerability was confirmed in the last 24 hours as affecting a component version listed in the DLL inventory. One fresh near-match, CVE-2026-96959, affects `System.Security.Cryptography.Xml` 8.0.0–8.0.4 and newer supported branches; the inventoried version is 7.0.1, so it was excluded.

The mandatory independent MongoDB ecosystem sweep identified five credible MongoDB Server advisories published on October 13. MongoDB is not present in the DLL inventory, so these are reported as required ecosystem findings rather than DLL matches.

### Finding 1 — MongoDB process-memory disclosure

- **Product:** MongoDB Server
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-96297
- **Severity:** CVSS 6.0
- **Description:** A crafted `$_internalApplyOplogUpdate` aggregation pipeline can trigger use-after-free behavior and return unrelated data from server process memory.
- **Relevance:** Required MongoDB ecosystem sweep; relevant to deployments of MongoDB Server, including Community and Enterprise editions.
- **Affected versions:** 7.0 before 7.0.45; 8.0 before 8.0.34; 8.3 before 8.3.13; 9.0 before 9.0.2.
- **Sources:** [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [MongoDB 8.0 release notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/release-notes/8.0/)

### Finding 2 — MongoDB query resource-exhaustion denial of service

- **Product:** MongoDB Server (`mongod`)
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-96299
- **Severity:** CVSS 7.1
- **Description:** Nested internal schema-validation operators in a user-supplied query can cause cross-product evaluation and excessive memory consumption, potentially terminating `mongod`.
- **Relevance:** Required MongoDB ecosystem sweep; applies to authenticated users with read access on affected server versions.
- **Affected versions:** 8.3 before 8.3.13; 9.0 before 9.0.4.
- **Sources:** [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [MongoDB 8.3 release notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/8.3/)

### Finding 3 — MongoDB aggregation output disclosure

- **Product:** MongoDB Server
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-103965
- **Severity:** CVSS 5.3
- **Description:** Constant values in a `$bucket` aggregation stage can be misread as field references during query rewriting, allowing an authenticated reader to receive field values the query did not intend to return.
- **Relevance:** Required MongoDB ecosystem sweep; affects the server aggregation framework.
- **Affected versions:** 7.0 before 7.0.45; 8.0 before 8.0.34; 8.3 before 8.3.13; 9.0 before 9.0.4.
- **Sources:** [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [MongoDB 9.0 release notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/9.0/)

### Finding 4 — MongoDB collection-validator crash

- **Product:** MongoDB Server
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-104004
- **Severity:** CVSS 7.1
- **Description:** Collection validators using expressions that accept collations can crash MongoDB Server during document insertion.
- **Relevance:** Required MongoDB ecosystem sweep; directly affects server-side validation on vulnerable releases.
- **Affected versions:** 8.0 before 8.0.34; 8.3 before 8.3.13; 9.0 before 9.0.4.
- **Sources:** [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [MongoDB 9.0 release notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/9.0/)

### Finding 5 — MongoDB `mongos` authorization flaw

- **Product:** MongoDB Server / `mongos`
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-104005
- **Severity:** CVSS 7.1
- **Description:** Incorrect authorization in the sharded-cluster router can permit improperly authorized bulk-write behavior involving system namespaces.
- **Relevance:** Required MongoDB ecosystem sweep; applies to sharded MongoDB deployments using affected `mongos` versions.
- **Affected versions:** 8.3 before 8.3.13; 9.0 before 9.0.4.
- **Sources:** [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [MongoDB 9.0 release notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/9.0/)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official integrations and libraries. No additional credible advisory published inside the window was verified for those categories.

### Review priority

**Immediate review is recommended for any deployment running the affected MongoDB Server versions, particularly sharded clusters and systems that permit untrusted or lower-privileged users to submit queries or aggregation pipelines.** No immediate action is indicated for the DLL inventory from newly reported vulnerability evidence in this 24-hour window.
